consumer_contract: one entry per design (set_id, design_id, label, geometry, axis nulls, wall cusps with z_c/|B|/angle, cells with z_start/z_end/kind/mirror descriptors, stable flag) so the geometry screening's launch design and the MDO closures can define cells by actual separatrix intersections instead of channel fractions; consumers must carry the entry's label (SCREENING_L1A_FIELD_SEPARATRIX_CUSP_TOPOLOGY or P2_QUALIFIED_FIELD_SEPARATRIX_CUSP_TOPOLOGY) and must not read the mirror descriptors as probabilities
definition: wall cusp := intersection of the separatrix of an axis null with the straight dielectric wall; cell := wall interval between consecutive cusps (plus anode-side and exit-side partial cells); see protocol.json#definition_v3
